name: When The Wind Blew You Away
source:
Peter Byrne and Amanda Evans were best friends during childhood. But one day, Peter left, without any warning and without telling Amanda. Ever since, she has felt resentment towards her childhood friend, but also felt lost: to make new friends, she resorted to being as generic as she could. But when the wind brings Peter back into her life ten years later, maybe Amanda can find some answers about Peter, his moving out, her feelings and herself.

[From [url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/when-the-wind-blew-you-away]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
彼得·伯恩和阿曼达·埃文斯是童年时期最好的朋友。但有一天，彼得离开了，没有任何警告，也没有告诉阿曼达。从那时起，她对儿时的朋友感到怨恨，但也感到失落：为了结交新朋友，她只能尽可能地表现得平庸。但十年后，当风将彼得带回她的生活时，也许阿曼达可以找到一些关于彼得、他搬走、她的感受和她自己的答案。

[来自[url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/when-the-wind-blew-you-away]Itch.io[/url]]
